predictions.articleTitle: Tremblay vs Maisons Alfort Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can R3 Giant-Killers Extend Cup Run?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Tremblay's Régional 2 home edge meets Maisons Alfort's compact knockout discipline in a tight, low-scoring tie favoring Home Win / Draw and Under 2.5 goals.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw led by Tremblay's 1.20 goal expectancy and home control (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 goals supported by a 2.25 combined lambda and 60.9% Poisson baseline (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
1:1 draw contingency if Maisons Alfort's counter-attacking block holds regulation level (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Seventh-round Parisian derby tests R2 hosts against R3 giant-killers.

spf.comment: Covers a narrow 1:0 home breakthrough and a 1:1 stalemate, as a 0.15 lambda gap and Maisons Alfort's knockout resilience make a single call overly rigid.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.25 combined lambda, 60.9% Poisson Under 2.5 share, and cautious single-elimination incentives.

score.comment: 1:0 reflects Tremblay's slight home-tier edge, while 1:1 captures the top Poisson density (13.3%) if the visitors frustrate the hosts.

goals.comment: 2 Goals (26.7%) and 1 Goal (23.7%) lead the Poisson distribution around a 2.25 total expectancy.

bqc.comment: A cagey opening half favors a level interval before Tremblay either breaks through late or settles for a regulation draw.
